description:
Message your teammates directly. Unlike reporting back to the lead, this reaches a peer teammate's inbox during execution — use it to request a clarification, hand off a sub-problem, or share a finding.

Actions:
- 'send': deliver a message. Set 'to' to a teammate's name for a direct message, or omit 'to' to broadcast to every teammate.
- 'inbox': read (and mark read) messages addressed to you. Poll this when you're waiting on a peer.
name: team_message

action.description: Send a message or read your inbox.

to.description: Recipient teammate name for a direct message. Omit to broadcast to all teammates.
